scripts.build:cloudflare: cd apps/frontend && bun run build && cd ../backend && bun run build:worker
scripts.verify:cloudflare: make typecheck && make test && bun run test:data-migration && bun run build:cloudflare && cd apps/backend && node scripts/test-worker.mjs
scripts.dev:cloudflare: cd apps/frontend && bun run build && cd ../backend && bun run dev:cloudflare
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: bun run verify:cloudflare && cd apps/backend && bun run deploy
